description: Record that existing customers gave the business permission to email them, with evidence_ref saying where that permission came from. Pass lead_id and email for one customer, or emails for up to 200. Addresses that are not existing customers are skipped and listed. Sends no email. Needs an admin of the business. Each record states that the owner holds that permission.

business_id.description: The business that sends the email.

emails.description: Email addresses of existing customers, up to 200, as an alternative to lead_id.

evidence_ref.description: Where the permission came from or why it is withdrawn, e.g. 'web form opt-in' or 'customer asked to stop'.

expires_at.description: Optional: when the permission ends (ISO date).

lead_id.description: One existing customer (lead id), paired with email.

name: record_email_consent
title: Record Email Permission
